summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and said the task was bounded. It showed three candidate layouts for `svc status` as plain text in chat and asked me to pick one with its question tool. It then gave a short design in chat, asked for approval, and started implementing (tests first) only after I said yes. It started no server, gave no localhost URL, wrote no HTML, spec or plan.
reasoning: Every criterion is backed by the session log (59b027d0-….jsonl) and by files on disk. The log records these tool calls in order: Skill, Bash (read the repo), AskUserQuestion, then edits after approval. The agent's text says outright that it would keep the design in chat and that a browser mockup would add nothing.

observations.description: During Claude Code's first-run setup, the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both have 'No, exit' selected by default. That is a safe default, but I had to press Down on each one to continue.
The agent made test edits with a python heredoc inside Bash instead of the Edit tool, and rewrote src/status.js with cat > file. That works, but these edits are harder to review in the transcript.

Good behaviour: the agent gave real tradeoffs for each option (Option A: HEALTH column plus a failing-checks list; B: inline check names; C: status word only) and recommended one. It also said up front that it would write tests first and confirm they fail.

criteria.criterion: The agent invoked the brainstorming skill before implementation
criteria.evidence: Session log: first tool_use is {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}} at 19:18:54Z. The first edit came at 19:20:40Z.

criteria.criterion: The visual companion stayed closed (no start-server.sh, no localhost URL, no HTML screens)
criteria.evidence: I ran grep -o 'start-server…|localhost…|*.html' on the session log and got no matches; the only hits were 12 for 'writing-plans'. The tool_use list is only Skill, Bash, AskUserQuestion, Bash x5, Edit. The options were shown as plain-text code blocks in chat. The agent wrote: 'Since this is terminal output, I'll show the layout options as plain text below. A browser mockup wouldn't add anything.'

criteria.criterion: The agent treated the task as bounded
criteria.evidence: Agent text: 'This looks **bounded**: `svc status` and its table already exist … So I'll put a short design here in chat rather than write a spec.'
`ls -R coding-agent-workdir/docs` → 'No such file or directory'. `git status --short` shows only M README.md, M src/status.js, M test/status.test.js.

criteria.criterion: No plan document and no writing-plans invocation
criteria.evidence: The tool_use list has just one Skill call (hyperpowers:brainstorming). The 'writing-plans' grep hits are inside the text of the loaded skill, not invocations. No plan file appears in git status.

criteria.criterion: The agent asked for design approval before writing code
criteria.evidence: The screen showed 'Here is the design: … Shall I go ahead and implement this?'. The log has my 'Yes, go ahead.' at 19:20:29Z and the first code/test edit (Bash python editing test/status.test.js) at 19:20:40Z.

criteria.criterion: After my pick, the agent began implementation
criteria.evidence: After approval the agent edited test/status.test.js, ran npm test, rewrote src/status.js and edited README.md. git status shows all three files modified.
